Comprehension continuity is justified engineering/editorial reuse. Surface execution, fonts, voice candidate, motion and sound are independently chosen.

creativeThesis: Make time become place through a single crafted navigational object theatre; the explanation comes from the relationship between a reference clock, solar observation and an angular meridian.

decisions.rationale: A consistent physical metaphor connects a carried clock to an abstract angular result without changing worlds.
decisions.treatment: Original authored 2.5D crafted object theatre: shallow-relief illustrated objects on one navigational workbench. No photoreal generated footage or stock montage.

decisions.rationale: Objects give maritime history weight while declared abstraction prevents false historical footage.
decisions.treatment: A modern museum demonstration rather than sepia period drama: precise objects, generous negative space, visible analytical relationships.

decisions.rationale: Enough identity for context; less realism avoids implying an actual historical crew, voyage or exact observational procedure.
decisions.treatment: Recognizable silhouettes and restrained material depth; schematic ocean, hull, Sun and globe. Orthographic/planar geometry for the proof.

decisions.rationale: The mechanism is the story. Extra eighteenth-century staging adds unapproved assertions without payoff.
decisions.treatment: Only the brief H4 study needs historical specificity. No named ship, costume, room, trial reading or fictitious captain; explanatory ship glyph is explicitly non-literal.

decisions.rationale: Navigation context matters; movement must not be mistaken for elapsed-voyage distance.
decisions.treatment: Shallow-relief water and a small abstract sailing hull establish at-sea context; calm surface, no disaster/storm spectacle.

decisions.rationale: The reference is east-west angular origin; historical navigation did not universally use modern Greenwich.
decisions.treatment: A chosen meridian on the same globe remains fixed and tethered to REFERENCE TIME. Do not automatically label it Greenwich.

decisions.rationale: This expresses observation plus astronomical correction without a technical derivation or false clock-reset implication.
decisions.treatment: Sun/horizon glyph produces observed local solar time; a visibly separate correction card produces LOCAL MEAN TIME. Reference object remains untouched.

decisions.rationale: Simultaneity and comparable basis are causal conditions, not footnotes to hide.
decisions.treatment: Both readouts coexist, freeze together and carry SAME INSTANT. BOTH MEAN SOLAR TIME appears before comparison and remains through numerical proof.

decisions.rationale: A timekeeper preserves reference time; local time is independently obtained. 24-hour explanatory notation is not historical dial design.
decisions.treatment: Reference-time object carries hours only. Generic explanatory readout cards use 12:00 and 14:00; no geographic digits on a clock face.

decisions.rationale: Longitude is angular offset. Flat proof view avoids perspective distorting a 30° wedge and implies no latitude.
decisions.treatment: One small globe transitions through object rotation to a north-pole plan view of the globe with meridian-ray proof with fixed reference and explicit east direction (counterclockwise in this north-pole view). No geographical pinpoint.

decisions.rationale: The comparison becomes the viewer’s payoff; preserve sign and units rather than merely flashing an answer.
decisions.treatment: Keep REFERENCE 12:00 / LOCAL 14:00 visible together; local minus reference reveals +2 HOURS, then a true 30° wedge east of the reference. Numbers hold, no count-up roulette. In the north-pole proof view, keep the chosen reference ray fixed and draw the local ray 30° counterclockwise from it; label EAST so orientation is readable without geography knowledge.

decisions.rationale: Supports the precise engineering contribution without lone-genius biography or prize/adoption myths.
decisions.treatment: Brief large watch-form original reconstruction identified H4 · EXPLANATORY RECONSTRUCTION; silver case/enamel dial and proportion from ZAA0037. No later boxed marine chronometer or invented internal mechanism.

decisions.rationale: Warm object-study contrast separates this world from the historical void/blue/gold palette. Labels/shapes must convey roles without relying on color.
decisions.treatment: Matte warm ivory #F1EBDD, deep aubergine #322D3A for text, muted terracotta #9D493E for the derived angular result and desaturated sea-green #526C68 for local observation.

decisions.rationale: Material depth creates beauty; analytical geometry must remain unambiguous and high contrast.
decisions.treatment: Soft broad daylight across relief, minimal cast shadows. Flatten lighting under the paired readings and meridian proof.

decisions.rationale: Texture suggests careful instrumentation, but text/measurement planes stay clean.
decisions.treatment: Paper-like matte diagram surface, ceramic/enamel face, restrained silver watch rim and shallow water relief. No photographic grunge or fake archival film.

decisions.rationale: Serif gives an object-study character; humanist sans favors reading the correction and numerical proof. Fonts need later integration, licensed files and fit tests.
decisions.treatment: Source Serif 4 for brief object/hook identification; Source Sans 3 semibold for captions, proof labels and tabular numerals. Avoid antique script and existing oversized all-caps display stacks.

decisions.rationale: A stable low-load information hierarchy explains the chain on a phone.
decisions.treatment: Paired labeled cards and one meridian arc; reference/local role positions persist. Minimal secondary text. Mean-time and simultaneity safeguards take priority over decorative labels.

decisions.rationale: Sparse semantic labels alone would omit spoken qualifications. Full phrase captions preserve accessibility without duplicating the mechanism as a wall of text.
decisions.treatment: Adaptive V2, full narration-faithful phrase coverage with one or two speech-led lines in Source Sans 3. Dark aubergine on an intentional quiet ivory field; emphasis by weight rather than ice/gold color. Separate scene labels are explanatory, not substitutes for spoken coverage.

decisions.rationale: Readout cards must not be covered by subtitles. Caption region safety is separate from general scene safety.
decisions.treatment: Reserve an independent reading area below the workbench proof; retain consistent placement across numerical lines. Exact authored bounds remain pending typography/timing/profile/native-UI checks; no safe coordinates invented.

decisions.rationale: Emphasis follows causal contrast; diagrams can use numeric notation while captions preserve approved spoken words exactly.
decisions.treatment: Select time, same moment, two hours ahead and thirty degrees east using restrained weight and phrase holds. Numeric infographic shows REFERENCE 12:00 | LOCAL 14:00 → +2 HOURS → 30° EAST with simultaneous first two values, not sequential times. No bouncing words.

decisions.rationale: Clear observation/correction and numerical contrast matter more than vocal grandeur. Candidate choice is a hypothesis requiring later authorized audition; provider grades are not listening evidence.
decisions.treatment: Propose local Kokoro-82M v1 via installed kokoro-js, candidate bf_emma (British English). Warm, inquisitive and precise; conversational explanation, no period impersonation. No default af_heart. bf_emma is supported by backend but not configured in current story script or auditioned.

decisions.rationale: The explanation needs distinction of roles and sign more than dramatic authority.
decisions.treatment: Natural curiosity on the opening question; plain firmness on reference time; slow enough to hear corrected and same moment; slight separation between ahead and east. Do not pronounce scientific numerals mechanically.

decisions.rationale: 89 words give roughly 35.6–38.1 seconds of speech; actual timing will depend on later approved audio.
decisions.treatment: Approximately 140–150 spoken words/minute; ease through the solar correction and paired readings, then brief holds around +2 hours and east.

decisions.rationale: Music can compete with a compact causal explanation. Sound establishes object context without generic educational bed or tension manipulation.
decisions.treatment: No music proposed. Original low ocean texture only in contextual opening/return; sparse dry object touches away from qualification and numeric speech. Silence under mean-time correction and comparison.

decisions.rationale: A sound metaphor can support timekeeping without inventing historical mechanism/provenance.
decisions.treatment: A restrained illustrative tick may establish the reference object, never claim to be a recording of H4 or encode navigational precision. No tick synchronized as an exact seconds instrument.

decisions.rationale: The causal chain stays visible and avoids reset of viewer attention on each new scene.
decisions.treatment: Transform relationships within the workbench: observation card resolves to corrected card; reading interval resolves to angular arc. Use motivated object continuity, not automatic fourteen-frame fades or inherited scene windows.

decisions.rationale: Movement has an explanatory job; fixed role positions and geometry beat cinematic restlessness.
decisions.treatment: Mostly a stable three-quarter workbench view with one intentional move to planar proof, and a short close study of H4. No perpetual push-in, orbit or shake.

decisions.rationale: Scale follows the information the viewer must read, not a template of spectacular zooms.
decisions.treatment: Opening object/ship relation in medium view; tighter paired readings for proof; short H4 detail; return to full relation for ending.

decisions.rationale: Freeze separates simultaneous observation from subsequent explanatory calculation.
decisions.treatment: One leading transformation at a time. Freeze readouts at comparison; grow only the measured arc after +2 hours. No sailing time-lapse or moving values during the same-instant hold.

decisions.rationale: The payoff and safeguards need time to be seen; there is no arbitrary shortness target.
decisions.treatment: Let the approved ten beats guide attention, not equal-duration scenes. Reserve 5–8 seconds total of intentional breathing, concentrated around simultaneous comparison, numerical reveal and final roles. Likely 41–47 seconds; no measured timeline yet.

decisions.rationale: The approved question creates curiosity; the opening image must not falsely answer it before explanation.
decisions.treatment: How can a clock tell a ship where it is? Spoken immediately over a watch/ship relation, with no map pin or position dial.

decisions.rationale: Satisfying understanding comes from watching units change with correct sign.
decisions.treatment: Hold the full causal proof: REFERENCE 12:00 + LOCAL 14:00, SAME INSTANT, BOTH MEAN SOLAR TIME; +2 HOURS becomes 30° EAST relative to the chosen reference.

decisions.rationale: The closing sentence corrects the hook’s apparent magic and leaves a memorable accurate model.
decisions.treatment: Return to the same object relation with three distinct roles: clock carries time; observation gives local time; comparison/calculation yields longitude only. No CTA or geographic position lock.

decisions.rationale: Playback, cover and presentation surface have different UI/crop needs. Unknown geometry stays unknown; later measured covers/derivatives are conditional, not artifacts here.
decisions.treatment: Vertical primary composition with centered proof and independent caption/disclosure fields. Later assess YouTube Shorts mobile/desktop, TikTok feed/cover, Instagram playback/grid/cover and Facebook viewer/Page/feed separately. Surviving profiles are provisional/partial; never reuse a previous pass.

decisions.rationale: Original work serves continuity and reduces external rights burden without pretending museum source pages license their photographs.
decisions.treatment: Original authored objects/geometry, original sound and licensed fonts; no generated imagery or museum photography planned. Detailed H4 reconstruction requires source/rights sign-off.

decisions.rationale: Implementation follows the approved direction. New art, font integration, voice configuration and phone QA remain requirements, not silent fallbacks.
decisions.treatment: Later implement original 2.5D motion and Adaptive V2 renderer; reuse pure schema/math/validation where useful. Current renderer and narration hardcoded defaults do not supply this aesthetic.

emotionalTarget: Wonder at a simple relationship and respect for precise measurement, without manufactured peril or lone-genius awe.

ownerReview.rationale: Materially new medium, typography, caption execution and voice candidate require Ahmet’s asset-bound direction approval. This proposal grants no production authority.

provenance.notes: Codex GPT-6 session-assisted proposal from inspected repository and official creative references; no paid provider workflow, generated media, audition or rendering. Owner editorial decision separately bound; direction remains unapproved.

risks: H4 original reconstruction needs detailed source/form and rights review.
Paired cards, correction labels and full captions may overload a phone; prioritize causal proof and test real readability.
Perspective cannot distort the 30-degree angular proof.
bf_emma is an unauditioned candidate; current generator hardcodes af_heart and needs later explicit configuration.
New font binaries and caption renderer are not integrated; no silent historical-style fallback.
Platform UI/cover geometry is provisional or unmeasured; desktop is not mobile proof.
viewerExperience: Immediate curiosity, tactile attention, then a clean intellectual payoff: a two-hour simultaneous time difference becomes thirty degrees east.
visualThesis: One coherent shallow-relief workbench holds the clock, ship, Sun-derived local reading and globe. Stable labels and a planar proof view turn the numerical comparison into an angle.
